name: Display cached dues when network is offline
title: SC-01-06-01 Display cached dues when network is offline
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given the resident has loaded the dashboard
And the device is disconnected
When the dashboard state is refreshed
Then the offline banner is shown and the last balance is kept
